summary: Equinix, Inc. filed an 8-K to report a public debt offering of $3.0 billion aggregate senior notes across four tranches: $850M 5.000% notes due 2029, $650M 5.500% due 2033, $650M 5.800% due 2036 issued by the parent, and $850M 5.250% notes due 2031 issued by Europe 2 Finco, a wholly-owned subsidiary, fully guaranteed by Equinix. Europe 2 Finco entered cross-currency swaps to convert its dollar obligation to euros, resulting in an effective 3.95% rate. The offering is a routine financing event with no special-situation elements.
